title: docs(locale): restore accents in the language notes
body:
## Summary

Restore “résumé”, “niño”, and “mañana” in the language guide. The ASCII spellings made the examples awkward for readers who use those languages.

## Boundaries

This concerns explanatory text; no translation loader or filename rules change.

## How I would check it

Preview the Latin and Japanese pages with the project renderer and inspect accented glyphs and punctuation for missing-glyph boxes.

files.patch:
diff --git a/docs/locale-guide.md b/docs/locale-guide.md
--- a/docs/locale-guide.md
+++ b/docs/locale-guide.md
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 # Localization notes
 
-The resume page keeps the names supplied by translators.
-The Spanish example reads: El nino vuelve manana.
+The résumé page keeps the names supplied by translators.
+The Spanish example reads: El niño vuelve mañana.

diff --git a/docs/ja/overview.md b/docs/ja/overview.md
--- a/docs/ja/overview.md
+++ b/docs/ja/overview.md
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 # 翻訳ノート
 
-設定を保存したら、次へ進みます,
+設定を保存したら、次へ進みます。
